name: d2r_ns_2g
title: Je-暗黑破坏神II_NS（2G版）
runtime: D2R Linux ARM64 94012, C197 classic 2G profile
devices: RK3566 classic 2G profile; verified on 4 GB MiniLoong Pocket One
license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; D2R Linux runner retains MIT

portmaster.desc: Launcher for the separate classic 2G adaptation, using an explicitly prepared D2R Linux installation. The profile name does not certify 2 GB hardware gameplay.
portmaster.inst: Prepare/install the 94012 classic runtime and resources first, then import its generated entry with D2R_NS_2G_ENTRY when building. Existing rk3566-2gb saves remain in place.

notes: The maintained NS launcher uses the classic 2G profile. Installation paths are explicit; game data and player state are excluded.
